gerard.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / sprite direction variants.
Use the supplied existing commentator atlas as the identity, clothing, eye clarity and drawing reference. Create a SUPPLEMENTAL gaze-and-shoulder atlas of EXACTLY FOUR equal columns and TWO equal rows, same 4:2 cell proportions and character scale. One identical commentator in all cells. Flat broad inked shapes and limited palette as reference, solid #091423 background, same horizontal navy railing baseline. Keep both open eyes readable, ivory sclera and dark pupils. Chin stays mostly upright, no bowed head or hidden eyes. Head yaw no more than 20 degrees, both eyes stay visible; no profile view.
Top row mouths CLOSED, bottom row corresponding IDENTICAL pose/head/gaze with mouth OPEN speaking, no alignment drift. Forearms lean on the rail, hand positions fairly quiet. Shoulder and chest can shift slightly with the head, but the rail must never move and the body must stay centered within each cell. Natural restrained human expressions, not cartoon grimaces. No fine photographic detail, gradients, excessive texture, text, labels, grid or watermark.
The goal is FOUR DIFFERENT readable directions for a short conversational animation. Do not repeat the same pupils and head in all four columns.
GERARD, seated LEFT of his companion: rugged receding dark hair, short gray/dark beard, headset, pastel blue Hawaiian shirt with big yellow lemons and red flowers, navy undershirt.
COL1: watches the arena just below, near frontal, pupils lowered slightly toward viewer RIGHT, shoulders square.
COL2: quick scan to viewer LEFT with mostly eyes, head nearly frontal, open eyes.
COL3: looks at his companion on viewer RIGHT at roughly eye level; head turned 15-20 degrees RIGHT, shoulders shift 8 degrees RIGHT. A clear conversational side glance, both eyes visible and chin level.
COL4: turns back toward the arena below on viewer RIGHT, head 8 degrees right and 8-10 degrees down, open visible eyes, shoulders settle back.
The positions MUST be distinct: neutral, eyes left, talking to partner right, returning down-right. Preserve his original ordinary rugged face; no overly serious anger and no exaggerated smiles.

layout.presenters: Centered, adjacent; slight shared rail overlap
layout.speech: Gerard left, Rene right; last utterance per speaker retained

motion.clock: Real presentation time, independent of simulation speed
motion.partnerLook: Brief during a speaking turn and periodically
motion.otherLooks: Eye scan to outer side; shoulders turn toward partner; return to arena

budget.mode: Automatic proportional redistribution with deterministic integer remainders
budget.drag: Other weights use the proportions present at drag start
